caption: The drawing depicts an object that resembles a symmetrical, stylized metal or wooden ornament. The main feature consists of two bird-like figures facing each other, each with an open beak and legs bent at right angles. The birds are decorated with arrow-like markings on their bodies and wings. Below the birds, there is a horizontal bar or base, and beneath this base is a mirrored version of the upper shape, but more abstract and geometric, featuring a jagged lower edge and two central circular elements, each with a star-like design inside. The entire composition is rendered in shades of green with subtle blue accents, suggesting the appearance of patina or oxidized metal. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing includes a signature or name and location written in green at the bottom right corner: "Mabel G. Claflin, Taos."
title: Bird Shelf
